order_param_is_memory_copy.meaning: the order parameter passed to _updateLimitPostOrder is a memory variable (temporary copy), not storage

previous_tail_order_exists.meaning: a previous tail order exists in the limit price level to which the new order is being linked

new_order_prev_link_stored.meaning: in storage, the new order's backward link (prevOrderId) points to the previous tail order

preceding_orders_permanently_lost.meaning: preceding orders are permanently lost from the limit price level's order book

assumptions: The order book is a doubly-linked list of limit orders with prevOrderId/nextOrderId links.
The previous tail order is the order currently at the tail of the limit price level before the new order is linked.
Storage is the authoritative state of the order book; the memory copy is discarded after the call.

unresolved.description: Report does not state a concrete storage field or getter that exposes the new order's stored prevOrderId, so the stored backward-link observable is bound only as a report-level Boolean rather than a numeric/address equality.
Report does not specify whether the previous tail order is the head or a non-head order, nor the exact removal sequence that produces permanent loss of preceding orders.

limitations: Only the permanent_loss_of_preceding_orders impact is formalized; other listed impacts are handled in separate claim-generation passes.
The bidirectional-link intent is represented as a state-correspondence obligation over the stored backward link and the absence of permanent loss, not as a full list-integrity proof.
No concrete order IDs, price levels, or caller/authorization conditions are supplied by the report.
